intents.description: Battery draining quickly, overheating, or unexpected device shutdowns following iOS/iPadOS updates.
examples: My battery dies in 2 hours after updating to iOS 17.1! Help!
iPhone 14 Pro getting very hot and battery draining 50% in morning
Battery health dropped from 95% to 82% overnight
resolution_patterns: Guide customer to Settings > Battery > Battery Health to inspect Maximum Capacity.
Explain 48-hour post-update background indexing behavior.
Recommend Apple Authorized Service Provider if Maximum Capacity < 80%.

intents.description: Customer requesting a refund for App Store subscriptions, inadvertent in-app purchases, or pending return refunds.
examples: I was charged $9.99 for Apple Music after I canceled my subscription! Want a refund now.
Kid bought $100 in Robux by mistake, how do I get my money back?
Returned my MacBook 2 weeks ago and still haven't received credit on my Visa
resolution_patterns: Direct customer to reportaproblem.apple.com to review purchase history and submit refund claims.
For disputes > $50 or bank chargeback mentions, escalate immediately to human billing specialist.

intents.description: Customer Apple ID locked for security reasons, forgotten passcode, or two-factor authentication recovery.
examples: My Apple ID is locked for security reasons and I have a flight in 2 hours! Help!
iPhone disabled connect to iTunes and I forgot my screen lock passcode
Lost my trusted phone number and cannot receive two-factor verification code
resolution_patterns: Direct customer to iforgot.apple.com to reset password using trusted device or recovery key.
Explain Account Recovery waiting period protocol.
Escalate to human verification queue if customer has lost all trusted devices and numbers.

intents.description: iCloud storage full alerts, backup failures, photo sync errors, or upgrading storage tier.
examples: Getting iCloud storage full alert but I only have 500MB of photos. How to fix?
Why is my iPhone backup failing due to insufficient iCloud storage?
I upgraded to 200GB iCloud+ but my phone still says storage full
resolution_patterns: Direct user to Settings > [Name] > iCloud > Manage Account Storage to identify large backups/attachments.
Provide instructions on deleting outdated device backups.
Instruct on signing out and back into Apple ID to refresh storage quota.

intents.description: Inquiries regarding online Apple Store delivery status, tracking numbers, or delayed shipments.
examples: Where is my order W8892110? It was supposed to arrive yesterday.
UPS tracking says delayed due to weather, can I pick up at Apple Store instead?
Order status stuck on 'Processing' for 5 days
resolution_patterns: Guide customer to apple.com/orderstatus to view real-time carrier tracking.
Request customer send order details via private DM for carrier investigation if past delivery window.

intents.description: Wi-Fi dropping, Bluetooth accessories failing to pair, or AirPods disconnecting.
examples: AirPods Pro keep disconnecting during phone calls every 3 minutes
iPhone won't connect to home 5GHz Wi-Fi network after router restart
Bluetooth toggle grayed out in Control Center
resolution_patterns: Guide customer through Forget Network / Forget Device and re-pairing.
Recommend Reset Network Settings via Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone > Reset.
Provide official support article on AirPods firmware updates.

intents.description: Third-party applications crashing upon launch, App Store download errors, or iOS update verification hangs.
examples: Instagram crashes immediately when opening on iOS 17.2
App Store says 'Unable to Purchase' error code 5002
iOS update stuck on 'Estimating time remaining' for 4 hours
resolution_patterns: Instruct user to force restart device and verify available local storage in Settings > General > iPhone Storage.
Recommend offloading and reinstalling the problematic application.
Advise connecting to computer for iTunes / Finder update if OTA verification hangs.

intents.description: Customer threatening legal action, litigation, attorney involvement, or regulatory consumer protection complaints.
examples: Your terrible update bricked my iPad! I am contacting my lawyer and filing a consumer court lawsuit!
Selling defective hardware is fraud. My attorney will be in touch tomorrow.
Reporting Apple to the FTC and consumer protection bureau for deceptive billing
resolution_patterns: Mandatory Human Escalation: Do not attempt automated resolution.
Acknowledge customer frustration neutrally and route immediately to Senior Executive Relations / Legal Support Queue.

intents.description: Compromised accounts, unauthorized financial charges, phishing attempts, or device theft.
examples: Someone hacked my iCloud and is holding my photos for ransom!
Saw 5 unauthorized charges of $89.99 each from iTunes on my credit card tonight
Stolen iPhone with SIM swap, hacker trying to bypass Activation Lock
resolution_patterns: Mandatory Human Escalation: Immediate security triage.
Advise customer to initiate remote lock via iCloud.com/find from any browser.
Transfer immediately to Apple Security / Fraud Operations team.

intents.description: Broad inquiries, feature how-tos, trade-in value estimates, or ambiguous product questions.
examples: Does iPhone 15 support USB-C display out to 4K monitors?
How much trade-in credit can I get for iPhone 12 in good condition?
When does Apple Intelligence launch in my country?
resolution_patterns: Provide factual technical specs from official Apple documentation.
Direct to apple.com/shop/trade-in for appraisal estimator tool.
